test_title: SSC MTS Previous Year Paper (Held on: 7 July 2022 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: If 30% of a number is 15 more than 135, find 50% of that number.
solution:
Given: 

30% of a number is 15 more than 135.

Calculation:

Let the number be N.

According to the question,

30% of N = 135 + 15

⇒ 0.3N = 150

⇒ N = 150/0.3

⇒ N = 500

⇒ N × 50% = 500 × 50%

⇒ N × 50% = 250

**∴ 50% of that number equals 250.**
